title: Mass subadditivity for a difference of currents
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, all sets U, G ⊆ ℝ^P and all currents A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (SimonGMT GeometricCurrentOn U n), M_G(A − B) ≤ M_G(A) + M_G(B) in [0, ∞]. Conventions: A − B is the contract instance Sub, so (A − B)(ω) = A(ω) − B(ω). M_G(X) = X.massOn G is the supremum of ENNReal.ofReal(X(ω)) over ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn U n G. These are the test forms ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (TestFormOn U n: smooth, compactly supported in U) with tsupport ω ⊆ G and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(x)) ≤ 1 for all x, called admissible for M_G. Neither U nor G is assumed open.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U G : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), (A - B).massOn G ≤ A.massOn G + B.massOn G
